visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit dermatology clinic. A female doctor with short dark hair, wearing glasses, a face mask, and a yellow-and-white patterned sleeveless top, is leaning over a patient. She has a head-mounted magnifying device with an attached light and camera. She is using a cotton swab to apply a blue liquid treatment to the face of a patient who is lying down, eyes closed, with a hairnet and towels protecting their clothes. (2) A close-up shot shows a small white ceramic bowl containing green liquid, alongside a stainless steel tray with gauze and medical tools on a green surgical drape. The doctor is seen putting on white latex gloves. The background includes medical storage units and equipment. (3) The doctor continues the treatment, meticulously dabbing the blue substance onto the patient's cheeks and forehead. An assistant's hands occasionally enter the frame to help adjust the patient's position or the lighting. Digital blur is used to protect the patient's identity. (4) The final segment shows a graphic overlay on a textured gray background, displaying the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone number, and physical addresses in Taipei.
